title: Depth and Krull dimension of Binomial edge ideals
summary: Let $J_G$ denote the binomial edge ideal of a finite graph $G$ in the polynomial ring $S$. We determine all triples $(n,t,d)$ with $n\geq 3$ for which there exists a finite connected graph $G$ on $n$ vertices with ${\mathrm{depth}}(S/J_{G})=t$ and $\dim(S/J_G)=d$.
